NONE: › written abbreviation for
second noun(TIME)
› short form of is
（is的縮略形式）
› short form of has
（has的縮略形式）
› used to form the plural of nouns
（用於構成名詞的複數）
› used to show that the following thing belongs to the people or things named
（用來構成複數名詞的所有格）…的
› used to show that the following thing belongs to the person or thing named
（用來構成所有格）…的
› the house belonging to the stated person
（某人的）家
› UK the shop belonging to the stated person
（某人的）的商店
› informal short form of does (only used in spoken questions)
（does的縮略形式，僅在口語中用於問句）
› short form of us (only used after "let")
（us的縮略形式，僅用於 let 後）

example: 今天下午我們去游泳吧。
I got it at the greengrocer's.
它是我從蔬果店裡買來的。
